question: Does a strictly gainful two-coordinate escape at native sparse-basis training stalls improve transferable causal predictions from genuinely disjoint observed actions under the same 16 weight-edit ceiling, without false confidence or loss of native cold retention?
scope: Development-only source-free algorithm/negative controls now; no CKAD02-09 original source replay, no unseen labels, source owner, native accepted model, live actions, external paid API, scheduler, controller, merge, deployment.

model.parent: yggdrasil/native_prior_hypothesis.py preserved byte-exact; reuse NativeContextAccumulator.restore for witnessed-only contexts and feature_row for native numerical monomial representation.
model.candidate: Separate opt-in NativePairHypothesis. Follow original deterministic best strictly positive single-flip edit until a one-flip local optimum. Only then search all unordered two-flip pairs for strictly positive net residual-error improvement; choose maximal gain, then fewest basis input bits, then smallest pair indices. Consume two actual edits, never overshoot MAX_EDITS=16; if no improving pair abstain/stop. Starting zero weights. No changes to CKAD09 readout or source.
model.quality: Retain 75/25 fit/calibration split and zero-fit-error, zero-calibration-error eligibility gate. Provisional readout only; otherwise abstain. Counts are not confidence estimates.
model.capacity: 11 total binary input bits, exactly same complete monomial basis max2048 weights; no learned grammar labels, new operators or prior privileged true rule. MAX_EDITS16. Native original cold checkpoint read-only.
model.cost: Record paired vs greedy CPU/wall and maximum search cost; no performance or resource claim without measurement.

existing_diagnostic: Previously exposed fabricated 4/5-bit parity monomial traps demonstrate greedy local optimum and a possible pair escape; excluded from prospective primary and not virgin scientific evidence.
source_free_tests: exact 4-bit fabricated trap where frozen greedy halts with positive residual and pair method solves within 16 edits
single-edit-only cases reproduce legacy greedy output
same pin isolated native evidence and no checkpoint mutation
cold serialized model exactly restores without source read
reject changed source identity and noncanonical/invalid traces

future_first_use.require: independent source owner + immutable source generator or licensed environment, separately authorized first-use and source pin; no source import during this engineering gate
future_first_use.source: independent tokenless interventions for six observed binary factors and one action bit, higher-order compositions; source owner's exact truth hidden until all predictions sealed
future_first_use.fit_calibration: first384 source-owner witnessed do-style outcomes, next128 calibration; all arms same available512 history and same frozen order
future_first_use.active_policy: fixed matching action sets; active exploration not separately tuned in this first pair-escape comparison
arms: fully fitted unpruned CART on all512
future_first_use.acceptance: Win >=5pp confident correct held coverage over strongest fully fitted conventional/symbolic/legacy control, <=1% wrong among confident answers, >=50% confident coverage, 95% world-bootstrap paired lower bound >0; zero input/held leakage, cold restore exact, same action observations; independently implemented exact symbolic pair parity must be disclosed and cannot be called unique native numerical superiority.
future_first_use.decision: No post-result threshold/seed/source or edit-budget changes; negative persists. Do not run future source on this authorization.
